title: त्रिचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 43 · Duryodhana humiliated in the hall

summary.en: Wandering through Maya's hall, Duryodhana mistakes crystal floors for water and water for floors, falls into a pool, and walks into a closed wall, while Bhima and others laugh. Burning with envy at the Pandavas' wealth and glory, he tells Shakuni he would rather die.
summary.kn: ಮಯನ ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸುತ್ತಾಡುವಾಗ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನು ಸ್ಫಟಿಕ ನೆಲವನ್ನು ನೀರೆಂದೂ ನೀರನ್ನು ನೆಲವೆಂದೂ ಭ್ರಮಿಸಿ ಕೊಳಕ್ಕೆ ಬೀಳುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಗೋಡೆಗೆ ಢಿಕ್ಕಿ ಹೊಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಭೀಮ ಮೊದಲಾದವರು ನಗುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಪಾಂಡವರ ಸಂಪತ್ತು ವೈಭವದ ಅಸೂಯೆಯಿಂದ ಉರಿಯುತ್ತಾ ಸಾಯುವುದೇ ಮೇಲು ಎಂದು ಶಕುನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: मय की सभा में घूमते हुए दुर्योधन स्फटिक के फ़र्श को जल और जल को फ़र्श समझ बैठता है, सरोवर में गिर पड़ता है और बन्द दीवार से टकराता है, जबकि भीम और अन्य हँसते हैं। पाण्डवों के वैभव से ईर्ष्या में जलता वह शकुनि से कहता है कि वह मर जाना पसन्द करेगा।
summary.te: మయసభలో తిరుగుతుండగా దుర్యోధనుడు స్ఫటిక నేలను నీరుగా, నీటిని నేలగా భ్రమించి కొలనులో పడతాడు, మూసి ఉన్న గోడను ఢీకొంటాడు; భీముడు మొదలైనవారు నవ్వుతారు. పాండవుల సంపద వైభవాలపై అసూయతో రగిలిపోతూ చనిపోవడమే మేలని శకునితో అంటాడు.
summary.ta: மயனின் ஸபையில் சுற்றும்போது துரியோதனன் பளிங்குத் தரையை நீர் என்றும் நீரைத் தரை என்றும் மயங்கிக் குளத்தில் விழுகிறான், மூடிய சுவரில் மோதுகிறான்; பீமன் முதலியோர் சிரிக்கிறார்கள். பாண்டவர்களின் செல்வம், சிறப்பு மீதான பொறாமையால் எரிந்து, சாவதே மேல் என்று ஶகுனியிடம் சொல்கிறான்.
summary.ml: മയന്റെ സഭയിലൂടെ അലയുന്ന ദുര്യോധനൻ സ്ഫടികത്തറയെ വെള്ളമായും വെള്ളത്തെ തറയായും തെറ്റിദ്ധരിച്ച്, ഒരു കുളത്തിൽ വീഴുകയും അടച്ച ഭിത്തിയിൽ ഇടിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു; ഭീമനും മറ്റുള്ളവരും ചിരിക്കുന്നു. പാണ്ഡവരുടെ സമ്പത്തിലും പ്രതാപത്തിലും അസൂയയാൽ വെന്തുരുകുന്ന അദ്ദേഹം, മരിക്കുന്നതാണ് നല്ലതെന്ന് ശകുനിയോട് പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 2.43; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Apr 19 2006

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
वसन्दुर्योधनस्तस्यां सभायां भरतर्षभ ।
शनैर्ददर्श तां सर्वां सभां शकुनिना सह ॥

meaning.en: Staying in that hall, bull of the Bharatas, Duryodhana with Shakuni slowly looked over the whole hall.

verses.text:
तस्यां दिव्यानभिप्रायान्ददर्श कुरुनन्दनः ।
न दृष्टपूर्वा ये तेन नगरे नागसाह्वये ॥

meaning.en: There the joy of the Kurus saw divine designs that he had never seen before in the city of Hastinapura.

verses.text:
स कदाचित्सभामध्ये धार्तराष्ट्रो महीपतिः ।
स्फाटिकं तलमासाद्य जलमित्यभिशङ्कया ॥

meaning.en: Once, in the middle of the hall, King Duryodhana, son of Dhritarashtra, came to a crystal floor and mistook it for water.

verses.text:
स्ववस्त्रोत्कर्षणं राजा कृतवान्बुद्धिमोहितः ।
दुर्मना विमुखश्चैव परिचक्राम तां सभाम् ॥

meaning.en: His mind deluded, the king hitched up his clothes, and, downcast and turned away, he walked around that hall.

verses.text:
ततः स्फाटिकतोयां वै स्फाटिकाम्बुजशोभिताम् ।
वापीं मत्वा स्थलमिति सवासाः प्रापतज्जले ॥

meaning.en: Then, taking a pool with crystal-clear water and crystal lotuses for dry ground, he fell into the water with his clothes on.

verses.text:
जले निपतितं दृष्ट्वा किंकरा जहसुर्भृशम् ।
वासांसि च शुभान्यस्मै प्रददू राजशासनात् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him fallen in the water, the servants laughed loudly, and at the king's command gave him fine clothes.

verses.text:
तथागतं तु तं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनो महाबलः ।
अर्जुनश्च यमौ चोभौ सर्वे ते प्राहसंस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him in that state, mighty Bhimasena, Arjuna and both the twins all laughed then.

verses.text:
नामर्षयत्ततस्तेषामवहासममर्षणः ।
आकारं रक्षमाणस्तु न स तान्समुदैक्षत ॥

meaning.en: Being intolerant, he could not bear their mockery, and, keeping his expression guarded, he did not look at them.

verses.text:
पुनर्वसनमुत्क्षिप्य प्रतरिष्यन्निव स्थलम् ।
आरुरोह ततः सर्वे जहसुस्ते पुनर्जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Again hitching up his clothes as if to wade across, he climbed onto dry ground, and the people all laughed again.

verses.text:
द्वारं च विवृताकारं ललाटेन समाहनत् ।
संवृतं चेति मन्वानो द्वारदेशादुपारमत् ॥

meaning.en: He also knocked his forehead against a door that looked open, and thinking another was shut, he stopped short at the doorway.

verses.text:
एवं प्रलम्भान्विविधान्प्राप्य तत्र विशां पते ।
पाण्डवेयाभ्यनुज्ञातस्ततो दुर्योधनो नृपः ॥

meaning.en: Having met such varied deceptions there, lord of men, King Duryodhana took leave of the Pandavas,

verses.text:
अप्रहृष्टेन मनसा राजसूये महाक्रतौ ।
प्रेक्ष्य तामद्भुतामृद्धिं जगाम गजसाह्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: and with a joyless mind, having seen the marvellous prosperity at the great Rajasuya sacrifice, went to Hastinapura.

verses.text:
पाण्डवश्रीप्रतप्तस्य ध्यानग्लानस्य गच्छतः ।
दुर्योधनस्य नृपतेः पापा मतिरजायत ॥

meaning.en: As he went, scorched by the Pandavas' splendour and wasted by brooding, an evil thought arose in King Duryodhana.

verses.text:
पार्थान्सुमनसो दृष्ट्वा पार्थिवांश्च वशानुगान् ।
कृत्स्नं चापि हितं लोकमाकुमारं कुरूद्वह ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the sons of Pritha content, the kings obedient, and the whole world, even to its children, devoted to their good, bull of the Kurus,

verses.text:
महिमानं परं चापि पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम् ।
दुर्योधनो धार्तराष्ट्रो विवर्णः समपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: and seeing the supreme glory of the great-souled Pandavas, Duryodhana, son of Dhritarashtra, turned pale.

verses.text:
स तु गच्छन्ननेकाग्रः सभामेवानुचिन्तयन् ।
श्रियं च तामनुपमां धर्मराजस्य धीमतः ॥

meaning.en: As he went, distracted, thinking only of the hall and the unmatched splendour of wise Yudhishthira,

verses.text:
प्रमत्तो धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तदा ।
नाभ्यभाषत्सुबलजं भाषमाणं पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana, son of Dhritarashtra, then heedless, did not answer Subala's son though he spoke again and again.

verses.text:
अनेकाग्रं तु तं दृष्ट्वा शकुनिः प्रत्यभाषत ।
दुर्योधन कुतोमूलं निःश्वसन्निव गच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him distracted, Shakuni said to him: Duryodhana, what is the root of this, that you go along sighing?

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वेमां पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां युधिष्ठिरवशानुगाम् ।
जितामस्त्रप्रतापेन श्वेताश्वस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana said: Uncle, seeing this whole earth under Yudhishthira's sway, won by the might of the weapons of great-souled Arjuna of the white horses,

verses.text:
तं च यज्ञं तथाभूतं दृष्ट्वा पार्थस्य मातुल ।
यथा शक्रस्य देवेषु तथाभूतं महाद्युते ॥

meaning.en: and seeing that Pritha's son's sacrifice, such as it was, like Indra's among the gods, greatly radiant one,

verses.text:
अमर्षेण सुसंपूर्णो दह्यमानो दिवानिशम् ।
शुचिशुक्रागमे काले शुष्ये तोयमिवाल्पकम् ॥

meaning.en: I am filled with intolerance and burn day and night, like a little water in the dry season of Shuchi and Shukra.

verses.text:
पश्य सात्वतमुख्येन शिशुपालं निपातितम् ।
न च तत्र पुमानासीत्कश्चित्तस्य पदानुगः ॥

meaning.en: Look: Shishupala was struck down by the chief of the Satvatas, and not a man there followed his lead.

verses.text:
दह्यमाना हि राजानः पाण्डवोत्थेन वह्निना ।
क्षान्तवन्तोऽपराधं तं को हि तं क्षन्तुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: The kings, burning with the fire raised by the Pandavas, forgave that offence; who else would forgive it?

verses.text:
वासुदेवेन तत्कर्म तथायुक्तं महत्कृतम् ।
सिद्धं च पाण्डवेयानां प्रतापेन महात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: That great deed was done by Vasudeva, and it was accomplished through the might of the great-souled Pandavas.

verses.text:
तथा हि रत्नान्यादाय विविधानि नृपा नृपम् ।
उपतिष्ठन्ति कौन्तेयं वैश्या इव करप्रदाः ॥

meaning.en: Thus kings bring jewels of many kinds and wait on the son of Kunti like tribute-paying Vaishyas.

verses.text:
श्रियं तथाविधां दृष्ट्वा ज्वलन्तीमिव पाण्डवे ।
अमर्षवशमापन्नो दह्येऽहमतथोचितः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing such splendour blazing in the Pandava, I am in the grip of intolerance and burn, though unaccustomed to it.

verses.text:
वह्निमेव प्रवेक्ष्यामि भक्षयिष्यामि वा विषम् ।
अपो वापि प्रवेक्ष्यामि न हि शक्ष्यामि जीवितुम् ॥

meaning.en: I shall enter fire, or eat poison, or enter the water; I shall not be able to live.

verses.text:
को हि नाम पुमाँल्लोके मर्षयिष्यति सत्त्ववान् ।
सपत्नानृध्यतो दृष्ट्वा हानिमात्मन एव च ॥

meaning.en: What man of spirit in the world will put up with seeing his rivals prosper and his own decline?

verses.text:
सोऽहं न स्त्री न चाप्यस्त्री न पुमान्नापुमानपि ।
योऽहं तां मर्षयाम्यद्य तादृशीं श्रियमागताम् ॥

meaning.en: I am neither woman nor not woman, neither man nor not man, if I endure today that such splendour has come to them.

verses.text:
ईश्वरत्वं पृथिव्याश्च वसुमत्तां च तादृशीम् ।
यज्ञं च तादृशं दृष्ट्वा मादृशः को न संज्वरेत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the sovereignty of the earth, such wealth, and such a sacrifice, who like me would not burn with fever?

verses.text:
अशक्तश्चैक एवाहं तामाहर्तुं नृपश्रियम् ।
सहायांश्च न पश्यामि तेन मृत्युं विचिन्तये ॥

meaning.en: I alone am unable to seize that royal fortune, and I see no helpers; so I think of death.

verses.text:
दैवमेव परं मन्ये पौरुषं तु निरर्थकम् ।
दृष्ट्वा कुन्तीसुते शुभ्रां श्रियं तामाहृतां तथा ॥

meaning.en: I consider fate supreme and human effort pointless, seeing that bright splendour of Kunti's sons so completely restored.

verses.text:
कृतो यत्नो मया पूर्वं विनाशे तस्य सौबल ।
तच्च सर्वमतिक्रम्य स वृद्धोऽप्स्विव पङ्कजम् ॥

meaning.en: Son of Subala, I made an effort earlier to destroy him, but overcoming it all he grew, like a lotus in water.

verses.text:
तेन दैवं परं मन्ये पौरुषं तु निरर्थकम् ।
धार्तराष्ट्रा हि हीयन्ते पार्था वर्धन्ति नित्यशः ॥

meaning.en: Hence I think fate is supreme and effort is pointless: the Dhritarashtras decline, the Parthas flourish daily.

verses.text:
सोऽहं श्रियं च तां दृष्ट्वा सभां तां च तथाविधाम् ।
रक्षिभिश्चावहासं तं परितप्ये यथाग्निना ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that splendour and that hall, and the mockery by the guards, I am scorched as by fire.

verses.text:
स मामभ्यनुजानीहि मातुलाद्य सुदुःखितम् ।
अमर्षं च समाविष्टं धृतराष्ट्रे निवेदय ॥

meaning.en: So, uncle, give me leave today, for I am greatly distressed; and tell Dhritarashtra about my overpowering anger.
